llm_none: no LLM (answer from the rule set)
warning_questionnaire_fields: The questionnaire asks for details the data model does not know: {fields}. Answers to them would be lost.
warning_corpus_missing: The legal corpus is missing ({corpus}). Build it first: {command}
warning_index_unavailable: The stored search index ({language_name}) is missing or does not match the corpus and was not used; the reason is in the log. Rebuild it: {command}
warning_index_build_slow: The stored search index is missing. Building it here with {model} would take hours, so search runs on the fallback model 'hashing-fallback': it compares words only, not meaning, and finds noticeably worse passages. The right fix is to build the index once — {command} — and store it as {files}. To wait here and now instead, set COMPLIANCE_HELPER_BUILD_INDEX=1.
warning_hashing_fallback: Search runs on the fallback model 'hashing-fallback'. It compares words only, not meaning — the passages found are noticeably worse. For production, build the search index: {command}
warning_no_llm: No LLM is reachable. The answer is built from the rule set alone and is therefore worded more briefly — its content is the same.
warning_rules_missing: The rule set could not be loaded, so nothing can be classified. The reason is in the service log.
warning_purpose_matching_switched_off: Purpose matching is switched off ({setting}). Classification then relies on the rule keywords alone and can miss a purpose that is described in other words.
warning_purpose_matching_no_model: Purpose matching is off because the comparison model (the cross-encoder BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3) could not be loaded; the reason is in the log. Classification then relies on the rule keywords alone and can miss a purpose that is described in other words.
warning_search_fallback: Search runs on the fallback model and compares words only, not meaning. The passages found are therefore worse.
rate_limit_hint: The limit protects the service from overload. It can be changed via COMPLIANCE_HELPER_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE.
error_unexpected: An unexpected error occurred in the service.
error_unexpected_hint: The details are in the operator's log.
error_unexpected_hint_retry: The details are in the operator's log. Please send the request again or contact the operator.

validation_body_shape: The request body must be a JSON object, sent with the header Content-Type: application/json.

http_413_hint: At most {kilobytes} KB are accepted per request.

questionnaire.roles.question: What is your role regarding this system?
questionnaire.roles.help: A provider develops the system or has it developed and places it on the market under its own name. A deployer uses a system under its own authority. The obligations differ considerably.
questionnaire.roles.relevant_for: Determines which set of obligations applies.
questionnaire.purpose.question: What is the system for? What is it meant to do?
questionnaire.purpose.help: The purpose determines the classification, not the technology. The same language model is harmless as a spell checker and high-risk in candidate selection.
questionnaire.purpose.relevant_for: Annex III, high-risk areas of use.
questionnaire.field_of_use.question: In which area is it used?
questionnaire.field_of_use.help: For example: human resources, lending, education, medicine, customer service, public administration.
questionnaire.field_of_use.relevant_for: Annex III names eight areas explicitly.
questionnaire.affected_group.question: Who is affected by the results?
questionnaire.affected_group.help: Employees, applicants, customers, pupils, patients, claimants — or only your own organisation.
questionnaire.affected_group.relevant_fo: Data subject rights and the impact assessment.
questionnaire.makes_decisions_about_peop: Does the result affect individual people — are they decided on, assessed or ranked?
Pre-screening is an effect too: whoever is filtered out goes no further.
Annex III and the profiling exception to Article 6(3).
questionnaire.human_oversight.question: Does a person review the result before it takes effect — and can they change it?
questionnaire.human_oversight.help: What matters is whether the person can genuinely intervene rather than merely confirm what the system proposed.
questionnaire.human_oversight.relevant_f: The derogation under Article 6(3) and human oversight under Article 14.
questionnaire.processes_personal_data.qu: Does the system process information that can identify a person?
questionnaire.processes_personal_data.he: Name, address, staff number, voice, image, but also an identifier that leads back to the person.
questionnaire.processes_personal_data.re: Whether data protection law applies as well.
questionnaire.special_categories_of_data: Does this include data on health, ethnic origin, religion, trade union membership, sex life or biometric data?
These data are specially protected under Article 9 of the General Data Protection Regulation.
Article 9 of the General Data Protection Regulation, impact assessment.
questionnaire.employee_data.question: Does it concern data of employees or applicants?
questionnaire.employee_data.help: Then, besides the Regulation, Section 26 BDSG (Federal Data Protection Act) applies, and usually works council co-determination as well.
questionnaire.employee_data.relevant_for: Section 26 BDSG (Federal Data Protection Act), works council.
questionnaire.biometrics.question: Does the system recognise people by physical characteristics — face, voice, fingerprint, gait?
questionnaire.biometrics.help: Several prohibitions under Article 5 and one area of Annex III apply here.
questionnaire.emotion_recognition.questi: Is the system meant to recognise people's emotions or moods?
questionnaire.emotion_recognition.help: Even if it is called a mood barometer, stress indicator or satisfaction measurement.
questionnaire.emotion_recognition.releva: Prohibited in the workplace and in education, Article 5(1)(f).
questionnaire.generates_content.question: Does the system generate text, images, audio or video?
questionnaire.generates_content.help: Generated content must be marked in a machine-readable format.
questionnaire.interacts_with_people.ques: Do people talk or write to the system directly?
questionnaire.interacts_with_people.help: A chat window, a voice on the phone, a help assistant.
questionnaire.embedded_in_product.questi: Is the system built into a product that has a safety function?
questionnaire.embedded_in_product.help: Machinery, lift, medical device, vehicle, toy — anything that needs CE marking.
questionnaire.embedded_in_product.releva: High risk via Annex I, Article 6(1).
questionnaire.is_gpai_model.question: Are you developing a general-purpose AI model yourself?
questionnaire.is_gpai_model.help: A model that can perform a wide range of distinct tasks and is integrated into other systems.
questionnaire.training_compute_flop.ques: How much compute was used for training, in floating-point operations?
questionnaire.training_compute_flop.help: From 10 to the power of 25, systemic risk is presumed. The number may be written as 1e25.
questionnaire.public_body.question: Are you a public authority or other public body?
questionnaire.public_body.help: Then the fundamental rights impact assessment and registration are added.
questionnaire.third_country_transfer.que: Is data processed outside the European Union?
questionnaire.third_country_transfer.hel: Even if only the provider's server is located there.
questionnaire.third_country_transfer.rel: Chapter V of the General Data Protection Regulation.
questionnaire.employee_count.question: How many people does your organisation employ?
questionnaire.employee_count.help: Small and medium-sized enterprises benefit from simplified documentation requirements.
questionnaire.market.question: Where is the system offered or used?
questionnaire.market.help: The Regulation also applies to providers outside the Union if the output is used in the Union.
questionnaire.hint: No question has to be answered. Every answer makes the classification more reliable; anything missing appears at the end as an open question.
